notes: The 1979 volume of the Recreation and Park Commission. Curated: dedications and rededications, the naming of Shoreview Park, architects' contracts and design approvals.

coverage.remaining: Routine items not curated. Not placed: the Knudsen-Bloom property design (Esherick Hornsey Dodge and Davis, $109,700, Apr 19; no page identified), the Upper Great Highway plan (Jul 24), a proposed renaming of Balboa Pool (referred only).
